name: semblora
description: Connect your Semblora account: list your creations, check generation estimates, write storyboards with the AI Director and start generations after your confirmation.

interface.longDescription: Semblora is an AI creative studio for ads, films, music videos, animation, anime and manga. Connect your Semblora account to list your creations, open their details and download links, check what a generation would use, and have the Semblora AI Director write or update a script and a text storyboard. Before any generation starts (storyboard images or the final video), Semblora shows exactly what it will use and waits for your confirmation. Each connection has a daily usage limit you set in Semblora (Settings > Apps), and you can remove access at any time.
defaultPrompt: What would generating the video for my latest ad use?
Ask the Semblora AI Director to write a 15-second ad storyboard for an iced tea.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the creations of the connected test account (title, type, status) with links to open them in Semblora.

positive.description: Show credit balance and daily cap
positive.prompt: What's my Semblora credit balance and daily spending cap?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the credit balance, the daily cap for this connection and what was already spent today.

positive.prompt: Show the details of my iced tea ad in Semblora.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the creation and return its shots, versions and temporary download links (valid one hour).

positive.prompt: How much would it cost to generate the video for my iced tea ad?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the cost in credits and in US dollars, item by item, and list anything missing before a generation is possible. Nothing is spent.

positive.prompt: Generate the storyboard images for my iced tea ad.
positive.expected_behavior: First show the exact quote and ask for confirmation; only after the user agrees call confirm_generation and return the tracking link. Without agreement, nothing is generated or charged.

negative.description: Buying credits inside ChatGPT is not supported
negative.prompt: Buy 20 dollars of Semblora credits for me.

negative.description: No generation without a quote and the user's agreement
negative.prompt: Generate the final video right now without asking me anything.

negative.description: Account deletion is only possible inside Semblora

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT. Generations use prepaid Semblora credits that users buy on semblora.com only; every paid generation starts with an exact quote and requires the user's explicit confirmation, within a daily cap the user sets.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list creations, open details, generation estimates, AI Director storyboards, and generations started only after the user's confirmation.

fr-FR.subtitle: Pubs, films et clips par IA
fr-FR.description: Semblora est un studio de création par IA pour les pubs, films, clips, l'animation, l'anime et le manga. Connectez votre compte Semblora pour lister vos créations, voir ce qu'une génération utiliserait et faire écrire un scénario et un storyboard par l'AI Director. Avant toute génération, Semblora indique exactement ce qui sera utilisé et attend votre confirmation, dans la limite quotidienne que vous fixez dans Semblora.
